title: BCIAUT-P300 dataset for autism from Simoes et al 2020
description: BCIAUT-P300 is a multi-session, multi-subject EEG dataset comprising 15 individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) performing a P300-based brain-computer interface task in a joint-attention training paradigm. The dataset includes 7 sessions per subject with 8-channel EEG recordings (250 Hz sampling rate) from visual P300 stimulation, providing a benchmark resource for developing and evaluating BCI classifiers in clinical populations.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using g.Nautilus wireless hardware (g.tec) at 250 Hz sampling rate from 8 channels (C3, Cz, C4, CPz, P3, Pz, P4, POz) referenced to the right ear with ground at AFz. The P300 paradigm involved visual presentation of 8 flashing objects with target and non-target stimuli. Data were preprocessed and epoched with a trial interval of [0, 1.2] s, bandpass filtered at 2.0-30.0 Hz, and organized into training (1600 trials) and test (400-4000 trials) sets per session.
